versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-security-health-check v0.0.1 - Initial Release

- Provides configuration baseline health checks and remediation checklists for Alibaba Cloud WAF 3.0, SAS, CFW, and DDoS (up to 60 items across 5 scoring dimensions)
- Generates three deliverables: customer-facing HTML report, ops Excel checklist, and internal Markdown summary
- Automatically detects products from input JSON; dynamic product coverage and explicit handling of missing/partial data
- Guided customer data collection with prebuilt scripts; strictly avoids handling credentials
- Dependency auto-install for scorer (pyyaml, jsonpath-ng, jinja2, openpyxl) upon ImportError, with zero user prompts
- Not intended for retrospective reporting, pricing, benchmarking, or proposal generation
